BrochureContent.Content:
Cedarmount Parkland Living with Heritage at its Heart

Cedarmount presents an exclusive collection of generously sized 4-bedroom homes, designed for modern family living in one of South Dublin's most prestigious locations.

Register Your Interest at: 
https://cedarmount.ie/#register-interest

Cedarmount presents an exclusive collection of generously sized 4-bedroom homes, designed for modern family living in one of South Dublin's most prestigious locations.

Interiors are carefully crafted with a focus on quality and functionality, incorporating bespoke kitchens with layered materials and intelligent storage, alongside contemporary bathrooms featuring integrated storage, feature tiling and ambient lighting. 

These homes sit within a beautifully landscaped parkland setting, offering both privacy and a strong connection to nature, while benefiting from A-rated energy efficiency and future-proofed design.

The addition of Cedarmount House as a shared amenity building elevates the living experience further, with spaces for work, leisure and wellness included as part of everyday life.

Key Features:
- Large 4-bedroom family homes
- A-rated energy efficiency
- Premium interior specification throughout
- Set within landscaped parkland grounds
- Exclusive access to residents' amenity spaces
